given.note: B4-30 on Alex's secure page: he types the street address, position 1. The page entry swaps first (nothing to swap: README default 50) and answers the read-back with the address as typed, shown back on this page only; it keeps the address with the read-back sealed under Alex's key and nowhere else, never in a span or a log (README defaults 48, 49; open gap 40). Nothing is written, nothing is geocoded yet. The read-back's id is a placeholder; the address is the master's sample.
